source.name: Hertz Global Holdings Q1 2021 Form 10-Q
source.notes: Filed 2021-05-07. DIP / super-priority face claim: Senior Secured Superpriority Debtor-in-Possession Credit Agreement principal outstanding at 2021-03-31, $750mm (latest balance public before the as-of date). USD millions.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Class 3 First Lien Claims (Senior Term Loan and Senior RCF) Allowed in the amount of $1,271,932,486.00 per Plan Art. III.B.3(b), before the Donlen paydown, post-petition LC draws, hedge claims and accrued interest the Plan adds to render the class Unimpaired. USD millions.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Class 4 Second Lien Note Claims (7.625% Senior Second Priority Secured Notes) Allowed in the amount of $362,750,694.00 per Plan Art. III.B.4(b), before post-petition interest. USD millions.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Class 5 Unsecured Note Claims, sum of the four Allowed amounts in Plan Art. III.B.5(b)(i): 804,522,222 (5.500%) + 926,700,000 (6.000%) + 503,211,806 (6.250%) + 511,083,333 (7.125%) = 2,745,517,361 USD = 2745.517361 USD millions. Excludes the ALOC Facility claims in the same class, which the Plan leaves to the Court to fix (drawn $142mm at 2021-03-31 per the Q1 10-Q), the $790.1mm HHN Notes guarantee claims (Class 6, paid by the issuer), and the $28.3mm 7.000% Unsecured Promissory Notes (Class 7 general unsecured).

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Subordinated debt: the Plan's classification table (Art. III.A) has no subordinated debt class; the Q1 2021 10-Q debt table lists no subordinated instrument. USD millions.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Class 11 Existing Hertz Parent Interests, the Plan's only Impaired class. Distribution value = cash of $1.53 per share (confirmed Plan Art. III.B.11(b)(i)) x 156,206,478 shares outstanding at 2021-06-10 (2021-06-16 8-K) = 238.995911 USD millions, + 3% of reorganized common (Plan Art. III.B.11(b)(ii)) at the equity value of approximately $4,700mm on which the Rights Offering is priced (2021-05-14 8-K/A; 0.03 x 4,700 = 141) = 379.995911 USD millions. The 30-year warrants (18% at a $6.5bn strike) or the alternative Rights Offering participation carry option value that is not disclosed and is excluded.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Plan distributable value to the six modeled classes = 750.0 + 1271.932486 + 362.750694 + 2745.517361 + 0 + 379.995911 = 5510.196452 USD millions. Every creditor class is paid in full in cash under Plan Art. III.B, so the value distributed equals the sum of the modeled claims plus equity's distribution. This is the Plan's distribution, not an independent enterprise valuation: the Debtors' valuation analysis sits in the Disclosure Statement on the claims agent site, which returns HTTP 403 to automated clients.

source.name: Second Modified Third Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization (Exhibit 2.1 to the 2021-06-16 Form 8-K)
source.notes: Filed 2021-06-16. Declared driver. Seniority rank of the subordinated debt row. Hertz has no subordinated debt class, so the rank is the template's positional slot between unsecured claims and equity, not a fact about Hertz. Basis: Plan Art. III.A classification table: no subordinated debt class exists; the row carries a zero claim.

source.name: Hertz Form 8-K: DIP Credit Agreement (Item 1.01)
source.notes: Filed 2020-11-03. DIP Credit Agreement commitment: superpriority secured delayed-draw term loans of up to $1.65 billion ($1.0bn for interim fleet financing equity, $800mm for working capital). USD millions. Replaces the earlier 7,500 read off the FY2021 10-K (filed 2022-02-24), which was hindsight for a 2021-06-30 case.

source.name: Hertz Global Holdings Q1 2021 Form 10-Q
source.notes: Filed 2021-05-07. Declared driver. Upfront fee as a share of drawn amount. The DIP fee letter is not on EDGAR; the credit agreement is on the claims agent site (HTTP 403). The value is the unamortized issuance cost on non-vehicle debt not subject to compromise divided by DIP principal drawn, both at 2021-03-31: 26 / 750. Basis: Q1 2021 10-Q Note 6: unamortized debt issuance costs (26) against DIP principal 750; attributing the whole 26 to the DIP is the assumption.

source.name: Hertz Global Holdings Q1 2021 Form 10-Q
source.notes: Filed 2021-05-07. DIP cash interest rate: 8.25% weighted-average rate at 2021-03-31 per Note 6, equal to the contractual LIBOR + 7.25% with a 1.00% LIBOR floor disclosed in the 2020-11-03 8-K.

source.name: Hertz Form 8-K: DIP Credit Agreement (Item 1.01)
source.notes: Filed 2020-11-03. DIP tenor in years: closing 2020-10-30 to maturity 2021-12-31 = 427 days / 365 = 1.169863.

source.name: Hertz Form 8-K: DIP Credit Agreement (Item 1.01)
source.notes: Filed 2020-11-03. Declared driver. Exit fee. The 8-K summary of DIP economics discloses rate, floor, step-down, maturity and draw size and names no exit fee; the credit agreement that would confirm it is not reachable. Held at zero. Basis: 2020-11-03 8-K Item 1.01 summary of DIP Credit Agreement terms lists no exit or prepayment fee.

source.name: Hertz Form 8-K: DIP Credit Agreement (Item 1.01)
source.notes: Filed 2020-11-03. Super-priority multiple 1.0x: the DIP is a superpriority secured facility with first priority liens on substantially all Debtor assets, consensual priming of the first-lien debt, and no roll-up.

source.notes: Filed 2021-05-07.
